newsitem.title: UK: UK shares slip after futures-led Far East slump.
newsitem.headline: UK shares slip after futures-led Far East slump.

text.p: UK shares opened sharply lower on Wednesday in response to declining S&P futures and losses in the Far East amid renewed nervousness over the Dow's resilience.
The FTSE 100 index -- dropping below the key 4,000 level soon after the start -- was 39.2 points lower at 3,996.5 points by 0842 GMT. Only three stocks were showing gains.
The December S&P 500 index future was trading 7.7 points lower by 0844 GMT, flagging around a 70 point drop in the Dow.
Weak futures traded on SIMEX had dragged Far East markets lower overnight. The Nikkei-225 and Hang Seng both ended with sharp losses.
